question: What is the worst thing you have ever done for money?
story: I got paid three hundred dollars to cry at a stranger's funeral. My college roommate worked at a funeral home, and one day he calls me and says, we have a problem. This man had no friends, no family showed up, and his lawyer set aside money to make sure the funeral looked full. So me and six other broke students put on suits and pretended to grieve. I was doing fine until the eulogy, when I realized nobody in that room had ever actually met him. And then I started crying for real. Ugly crying. People came up to ME for comfort. I told them stories about a man I never knew. His lawyer tipped me an extra hundred and said, you must have really loved him. Sir, I met him today. He was in the box.
